note: The why gives the learner the way to check themselves (smooth means in tune, a wobble means off), the bare drill stays at 3 minutes, and the second block turns it into tunes the learner makes up in a new key. Both staffs keep a beginner tenor at A4 or under, sung on "oo", and the text says to pick a Do that sits easily instead of the top one.

exercise.title: In tune over a drone: find the smooth spot
exercise.why: A note in tune with the drone sounds smooth and a note that is off wobbles against it, so the drone tells your ear when you are on the note.

cells.text: Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows on the staff as a line. Pick a {{1}} that sits easily in your voice and sing it on "oo". Slide a little above it and below it, until the wobble stops and the sound goes smooth: that smooth spot is in tune. Then find it on {{5}}.

Press Start exercise below: the drone is on A now. Make up short tunes from {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}} on "oo", and end each one on {{1}}. The key is new and the smooth spot sounds the same: listen for it on every note you hold.
